title: Telepathy Protocol (TP) 1.0 — JSON Schema Definitions (Edition 2025-10-25)
description: Frozen Telepathy Protocol 1.0 JSON Schema (Edition 2025-10-25). Defines the two-segment TP/1.0 wire envelope, FayIdentity with Human Prime attribution and Faying Mandate binding, the 3-layer Normative Cognitive Exchange Stack (Explicit Cognitive Frame Schema, Shared Ontology & Codebook Negotiation, Mandatory Structured Natural-Language Fallback), the gated Experimental Latent Research Track, SharedContext deterministic LWW synchronization, SSRF-guarded CognitiveResource references, CallbackCredential in-band revocation, content-free local hash-chained AuditRecord, Goal DAG & Consultation, and sibling/external bridge loss metadata.

ProtocolVersion.description: Two-segment TP wire protocol version MAJOR.MINOR (canonical "1.0" or qualified "TP/1.0"). Three-segment SemVer strings (e.g. "1.0.0") are invalid and rejected with TP-VER003.

FayID.description: Canonical ecosystem Fay identifier prefixed with ifay_ (individual Fay) or cofay_ (collaborative/organizational Fay) followed by lowercase RFC 4648 base32 characters.

CryptoSuite.description: Negotiated envelope signature suite. Ed25519 is mandatory-to-implement (MTI) in TP 1.0; ML-DSA-65 is the reserved post-quantum agility slot.

Sha256Digest.description: Lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 digest prefixed with sha256:.

DIDProof.description: DID proof for cryptographic identity verification.

DIDIdentifier.description: DID identifier with method, value, and cryptographic proof.

FayIdentity.description: Fay identity — globally unique FayID with DID verification, Human Prime attribution, and optional Faying Mandate reference.

human_prime_id.description: Human Prime identifier (MUST be present when fay_type is iFay).

fp_authorization_ref.description: Optional Faying Protocol (FP) mandate authorization reference.

CognitiveResourceType.description: Enumeration of shareable cognitive resource types.

CapabilityDescriptor.description: Describes a single capability of a Fay (mappable from SSP Skill Descriptors).

ssp_skill_ref.description: Optional Skill Sharing Protocol (SSP) canonical skill reference.

SharingWillingness.description: Declares what cognitive resources a Fay is willing to share.

FayStatus.description: Current operational status of a Fay.

AuthorizationRestriction.description: An explicit restriction placed by the Human Prime on Fay sharing.

PrimeAuthorization.description: Boundary of what the Human Prime has authorized this Fay to do and share via Faying Protocol.

OntologyDescriptor.description: Shared ontology and codebook version descriptor for TP 1.0 Normative Layer 2 negotiation.

ModelHomogeneityAttestation.description: Cryptographic digest attestation required for the optional Experimental Latent Research Track.

FayProfile.description: Fay profile exchanged during Step 3 of TP session establishment.

CognitiveFrame.description: TP 1.0 Normative Layer 1: Explicit Cognitive Frame exchanged when both Fays negotiate a shared ontology.

StructuredTextFallbackFrame.description: TP 1.0 Normative Layer 3: Mandatory Structured Natural-Language Fallback Frame ensuring 100% cross-implementation interoperability and Human Prime auditability when ontologies mismatch or confidence drops below threshold.

ExperimentalLatentFrame.description: Optional Experimental Research Track (NON-NORMATIVE in TP 1.0): Permitted ONLY when sender and receiver cryptographically prove identical base_model_digest and adapter_digest, and MUST include a human-auditable summary plus structured fallback frame.

audit_summary.description: Mandatory human-auditable summary preventing opaque black-box latent exchanges.

ResourcePermissions.description: Per-Fay resource permissions keyed by FayID.

InlineContent.description: Inline cognitive data strictly bounded at <= 64 KiB (65,536 bytes).

ReferenceContent.description: External cognitive content referenced by SSRF-guarded https:// URI (mandatory for > 64 KiB).

uri.description: HTTPS resource URI (loopback, RFC 1918 private, link-local, CGNAT, ULA, and file:// URIs are rejected with TP-RES002).

DtpTunnelContent.description: Cognitive content streamed over a bound Data Tunnel Protocol (DTP) encrypted channel.

ResourceAccessPolicy.description: Access policy for a cognitive resource.

ResourceNotification.description: Content-free proactive resource change notification payload (OQ-7). Carries metadata and SHA-256 digest only — never raw content.

MountedResource.description: A cognitive resource mounted into a SharedContext.

AccessControlList.description: Access control list for a SharedContext.

ContextLifecycle.description: 5-state lifecycle of a SharedContext: initializing -> active <-> syncing / suspended -> terminated.

SyncState.description: Synchronization state of a SharedContext ordered by monotonic (sync_version, updated_at, actor_fay_id) for deterministic LWW convergence.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of latest update.

actor_fay_id.description: FayID of the participant applying the update (deterministic tie-breaker).

SharedContext.description: Shared context — temporary mounting space for cognitive resources.

KeyExchangeInfo.description: Key exchange metadata for hybrid payload encryption.

encrypted_session_key.description: Base64-encoded wrapped session key or HKDF salt+nonce.

EncryptedPayload.description: AEAD encrypted payload protecting Human Prime private cognitive data.

CredentialScope.description: Least-privilege resource and operation scope of a CallbackCredential.

CallbackCredential.description: Scoped, time-limited callback credential supporting mandatory in-band revocation (credential_revoke) and optional HTTPS revocation_endpoint.

CredentialRevocation.description: Mandatory in-band revocation payload for MessageType = credential_revoke (OQ-12). Causes subsequent access with credential_id to deterministically fail with TP-C002.

AuditRecord.description: Content-free local hash-chained audit record owned and deletable under Human Prime retention policy (OQ-11). Never stores raw payload data, keys, or tokens.

Goal.description: Structured collaboration goal with DAG sub-goals.

cap_handoff_ref.description: Optional Control Authority Protocol (CAP) evaluation request reference when the Goal triggers physical/host device control.

PrimeDelegation.description: Human Prime delegation proof bound to a Faying Protocol mandate.

CommunicationTier.description: Communication tier negotiated in ProtocolContract. tier_1_native_tp and tier_3_structured_text_fallback form the TP 1.0 Normative Core; tier_2_ai_generated is disabled by default and experimental per OQ-9.

ProtocolContract.description: Agreed protocol contract binding transport, crypto_suite, ontology/codebook or mandatory structured text fallback.

LossMetadata.description: Explicit semantic degradation record attached when translating across protocol boundaries (OQ-10).

TraceInfo.description: Cross-protocol tracing and semantic loss metadata.

MessageType.description: Enumeration of all valid TP 1.0 message types.

MessageEnvelope.description: Transport-agnostic TP/1.0 wire envelope signed via RFC 8785 JCS + Ed25519.

signature.description: Base64-encoded signature over RFC 8785 JCS canonicalized envelope excluding the signature field.

icp_annotations.description: Optional lossless iFay Context Protocol (.ctx) structured annotations.

TPError.description: Structured error response with deterministic category-prefixed error codes.
